rix.text: Vona de Iedo, the Butcher of Magan, reaches the Immortal Sun for the Legion of Dusk in Rivals of Ixalan, where she and Mavren Fein tackle Kumena, wound him and throw him out of the tower window.

She then claims the Immortal Sun for the Legion of Dusk, and when Huatli and Tishana burst in she uses it to turn Huatli's blood against her, until Malcolm's song enthralls the chamber and Breeches leaps onto her face.
When Vona, Huatli, Tishana and Angrath all touch the Immortal Sun, a surge of energy passes through them and the Sun vanishes, and Vona cries out that it is gone.

Saint Elenda arrives and tells her followers they are free, since her order was meant to guard the Sun, not use it, and when Vona insults her, Elenda forces Vona to the floor with a magical command before the three vampires leave into the night.
